value.rationale: The recent odd-dimensional finite separability theorem motivates the minimal number of angular-offset factors as a geometric data-complexity invariant. This is a complete classification of a canonical noncentral family, revealing two exceptional prolate displacement surfaces with geometrically interpretable focal rank collapse and a distinct rank-four resonance. The exact minimum, rather than just finite existence, is material to low-rank section tomography.
